title: Walk a caller through steps they cannot skip
summary: Every step names one tool. Each step but the last names only its successor, so the next_step tool the model is offered has no backward or skip target.
scenario: Opening a roadside assistance request, three questions in order

folds: variant: gather_info typed answers without tools
evidence: gather_info variant is absent from the bundled schema.json (sdk-surface section 4); the claim does not depend on it
sdk contexts.py:490-533 Step.to_dict renders step_criteria, functions, valid_steps, end
sdk contexts.py:1215-1262 ContextBuilder.validate refuses an unknown valid_steps target
